title: 第224章 剑光垂落分割战场第223章 惊惧愤怒的王都官员贵族将军和平民
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
第224章剑光垂落，分割战场
卢泰西亚城外，忠于卡佩王室的军队将内昂城军队当做了敌人，如同潮水一般发起了进攻。
而内昂城的军队尽管战力并不弱，更有超凡扈从骑士坐镇。
但奈何得到过李凯南的命令，不愿意与卢泰西亚的军队爆发战斗，只能不断后撤。
也就在局势变得越发不可收拾的时候，一道横贯天际、恢弘璀璨的剑气自高空垂落。
只见白光如垂天之瀑，裹挟着碾压万物的凛冽威压轰然砸在两军战场正中。
“轰隆”一声巨响，霎时之间大地都为之颤栗，碎石冲天而起，烟尘遮断视线。
一时之间战马惊恐嘶鸣，立马停下了脚步，任凭那些忠诚的王室骑士们如何催促也不敢再上前一步。
片刻之后，遮蔽视线的烟尘逐渐散去。
而当这些忠诚的王室骑士们、卢泰西亚军队和王都民众们看清前方战场情况的时候，全部彻底呆住了！
从天垂落的恢弘剑气在大地之上劈开了一条延绵余里的沟壑，直接横亘在卢泰西亚的军队前方。
而在壕沟的对面，内昂城的军队也停止了后撤。
此刻所有人的视线，都聚集在了战场中央那道身穿着华丽鎏金铠甲、身披大红色披风的英武身影之上。
被矮人赐福加持的华丽鎏金铠甲，拥有着提振士气、震慑敌人的神奇力量。
而这种神奇的能力，也因为李凯南所展现出来的强大力量而显得效果更加明显！
内昂城军队士气大振，欢呼之声响彻四周。
而忠于卡佩王室的卢泰西亚一方，则明显受到了打击。
精锐的王室骑士们依旧保持着阵型，随时准备发起决死冲锋，但他们握着武器的手却是已经开始不住地颤抖。
卢泰西亚的军官士兵们，此刻面若死灰，军队明显出现了混乱。
而那些临时被分发到武器的王都民众们，更是已经出现了因为惊恐而四散溃逃的情况……

李凯南微微起身，看着并没有爆发大规模流血冲突的两边军队，心中不由稍稍松了一口气。
对于卢泰西亚，李凯南早已视作自己的力量！
而对于因为缺少足够的人才储备，而一直无法彻底整合卡佩王国的李凯南来说，这场冲突损失的每一个人都亏大发了……
打量着对面的卢泰西亚军队，李凯南非常满意。
王室骑士们精锐且忠诚，即便是面对自己这样极具压迫感的“敌人”也依旧准备着决死冲锋！
卢泰西亚里面的王都守军装备精良，而且能够快速集结响应，可见军事素质并不差。
那些被分发了武器的民众们属于是乌合之众，但李凯南却能够看出城中官员们有着相当厉害的物资调度和动员能力……
而现在这些精锐骑士、军官士兵和官员们，李凯南都能够以卡佩王室的名义一口气吞并下去！
李凯南心情大好，当即将手中的威权王道之剑收回腰间，当即朗声道：
“对面的诸位，我们不是敌人！”
“我是王国南境边疆伯爵、内昂城领主，我遵奉爱洛公主的命令，派遣部队守护沉睡中的王都卢泰西亚不被外来者入侵！”
content_en:
Chapter 224 The sword light falls, dividing the battlefield
Outside the city of Lutetia, the troops loyal to the Capetian royal family regarded the Neang army as enemies and launched an attack like a tide.
Although the army in Neang City is not weak in combat power, there are even extraordinary knights standing guard.
But Naihe had received orders from Li Kainan and was unwilling to break out into a battle with Lutetsia's army, so he could only keep retreating.
Just when the situation became more and more uncontrollable, a magnificent and bright sword energy fell from the sky across the sky.
The white light was like a waterfall hanging from the sky, and it crashed into the middle of the battlefield between the two armies, carrying a fierce pressure that crushed all things.
There was a loud "rumbling" sound, and the earth trembled for an instant, gravel rose into the sky, and smoke and dust blocked the line of sight.
For a moment, the war horse neighed in fear and stopped immediately. No matter how urged the loyal royal knights were, they did not dare to take another step forward.
After a while, the smoke and dust that obscured his vision gradually dissipated.
And when these loyal royal knights, the Lutecian army and the people of the royal capital saw the situation on the battlefield ahead, they were all completely stunned!
The magnificent sword energy falling from the sky opened a ravine that stretched for more than a mile on the earth, directly across the front of Lutecia's army.
On the opposite side of the trench, the troops in Neang City also stopped retreating.
At this moment, everyone's eyes were focused on the heroic figure wearing gorgeous gilt armor and a bright red cloak in the center of the battlefield.
The gorgeous gilt armor blessed by the dwarves has the magical power to boost morale and intimidate the enemy.
And this magical ability is even more effective because of the powerful power displayed by Li Kainan!
The morale of the troops in Neang City was greatly boosted, and cheers resounded all around.
The Lutetsia side, which was loyal to the Capetian royal family, was obviously hit.
The elite royal knights still maintained their formation, ready to launch a desperate charge at any time, but their hands holding weapons had begun to tremble uncontrollably.
The officers and soldiers of Lutetsia looked ashen at this moment, and the army was obviously in chaos.
And those people in the royal capital who were temporarily distributed weapons have even fled in panic...
Li Kainan stood up slightly and couldn't help but feel a little relieved when he saw that there was no large-scale bloody conflict between the two armies.
For Lutecia, Li Kainan has long regarded it as his own strength!
For Li Kainan, who has been unable to completely integrate the Capetian Kingdom due to lack of sufficient talent reserves, everyone lost in this conflict has suffered a huge loss...
Looking at the Lutecian army opposite, Li Kainan was very satisfied.
The royal knights are elite and loyal. Even when faced with an oppressive "enemy" like themselves, they are still ready to charge to the death!
The royal capital garrison in Lutetia is well-equipped and able to assemble and respond quickly, which shows that the military quality is not bad.
The people who had been distributed weapons were a mob, but Li Kainan could see that the officials in the city had quite powerful material dispatch and mobilization capabilities...
And now Li Kainan can annex these elite knights, officers, soldiers and officials in the name of the Capetian royal family!
Li Kainan was in a good mood. He immediately put the sword of authority in his hand back to his waist and said loudly:
"Everyone on the other side, we are not enemies!"
"I am the Earl of the Kingdom's southern border and the lord of Neang City. I obey Princess Aurora's order and send troops to protect the sleeping royal capital of Lutecia from outsiders!"
